items.purpose: Make local Heretic replies progressively visible under an explicit source-owned completion policy, project that progress into the actual Evolution Conversation, and smooth provider chunk cadence through a bounded adaptive human-consumption reveal without backpressuring inference. Partial progress remains ephemeral; one completed final response advances durable Conversation truth. PRs #928, #931 and #932 are accepted source, and A005 is terminal human-lived PASS.

items.label: Completed — tool-bearing VexLife Home
items.purpose: Make the lived Evolution Conversation the ordinary VexLife Home where Vex can perceive current Intent/Workgraph context, discover only source-admitted capabilities, exercise at least one bounded source-backed read/tool path through the accepted Intent Scheduler / capability-lease / ToolResultRelay seams, receive the bounded observation back into context, and explain the result conversationally. A006 terminally proves the first threshold on accepted Heretic/MLX source, including truthful model/self projection, durable readback and same-idempotency no-replay recovery. MODEL_PROPOSAL != EFFECT_AUTHORITY; CAPABILITY_DISCOVERY != ARBITRARY_ACCESS; TOOL_OBSERVATION != MEMORY_PROMOTION.

items.label: Later — Kokoro live speech + response Read control
items.purpose: Capture the user-controlled speech refinement without stealing current foreground: an optional Speak toggle may begin Kokoro playback while already-received response text is still arriving, with bounded backfill from text that arrived before speech began, and each completed response may expose a Read control. Speech is a presentation consumer: it must not block generation, fabricate unseen text, mutate durable Conversation truth or silently become always-on.

items.label: Later — refine Home/navigation from lived feedback
items.purpose: Treat the current Terrain nodes, menus and example screens as capability scaffolding rather than final visual design. Refine Home/navigation only from lived use and current product intention; do not search history merely to recover a supposedly lost final UI. This presentation work is separate from the current tool-bearing Home capability work, which owns lawful capability use through the lived Vex Conversation.

items.purpose: Prove the product can sustain a long real Victor ↔ local-Heretic session through progressive responses, rising context pressure, Memory bounding, checkpoint/rollover, restart/re-entry and owned-resource recovery without silent context loss, recursive summary stacking, arbitrary model cutoff or unauthorized cleanup.

items.purpose: Preserve the narrower qualified mainline threshold already proved: exact current VexLife source can establish/recover the local Heretic runtime and Browser/Companion path, complete a natural durable Conversation turn, and remain current afterward. This completed threshold does not claim that the ordinary source-update/recovery flow automatically reconverges an already-open browser document; that broader human-interface relationship is owned by the Interface Compound Relay work.

items.purpose: Make Evolution Conversation and the Vex Terrain/Open-conversation experience project one canonical project/thread/channel/current-head identity, so navigation and re-entry do not create two loosely related conversation frames. Preserve one durable Conversation truth owner; surfaces are bounded projections of that same thread/head.

Memory remains a separate owner from model weights and raw transcript history.

The capability substrate already exists and a bounded tool path was proven; this work closes the lived-awareness gap. CAPABILITY_SUBSTRATE_EXISTS != VEX_CURRENTLY_AWARE; AWARENESS != EFFECT_AUTHORITY.
